title: Warehouse automation in India: 2026 benchmarks
takeaways: 36.2 million sq ft leased in H1 2026, up 18% (Cushman & Wakefield)
India warehouse automation market seen at $1.42 billion by 2030 (CBRE)
56% of supply chain firms will raise innovation spend (MHI 2026)
Warehouse labour costs projected to rise 7% a year (Zebra)
Inventory robotics study: 219% three-year ROI, composite 3PL (Forrester)
source_note: Sources: Cushman & Wakefield 2026; CBRE 2026; MHI-Deloitte 2026; Zebra; Forrester
